newsitem.title: UK: UK grain cash and futures prices hit by currency.
newsitem.headline: UK grain cash and futures prices hit by currency.

text.p: Sterling's continued strength against other European currencies again took its toll on prices on the UK grain cash and futures markets on Thursday.
"Currency and a lack of sellers have been the main features of the market again," said one broker.
On the cash markets delivered material was trading about unchanged from Wednesday while little activity was reported on the fob market.
LIFFE wheat futures closed with new crop 0.80 to 0.60 stg down and old crop 0.05 stg up after trading 486 lots.
LIFFE barley futures finished 1.75 to 0.50 stg lower after trading 62 lots.
